brief.oneLine: A Hades run where boon altars offer a choose-1-of-3 pick of Isaac-style items instead of boons.
brief.isaacRole: Inspiration only: original items and names, no Isaac art or files. Make Isaac required only if the owner asks for it.
brief.firstMinute: Before the run, pick one starter item in the House of Hades. Then play normally; every boon reward shows 3 items to choose from.
brief.firstPlayableMustHave: About 15 items, boons replaced everywhere, effects: stats, poison, piercing, homing
brief.loaderPlan: Hades has no loader Melty installs by itself: bundle a community Hades mod loader if its license allows, with credit. Confirm with game_info and one_click_check.
brief.status: Design only. Nothing built or tested. Every hook below is unverified.
